bundle.shortDescription: Put a translation of a game's text back into the game
bundle.longDescription: ventris takes the text out of a game and puts a translation back in, in any alphabet. The app gets the translation packs from GitHub by itself, finds the game each one is for among your games, and builds the translated copy of the game.
